name: grovers_search_lab
description: The Grover's Search lesson's lab: H, the fixed oracle for the item 01 (X, CZ, X on q1), one diffusion, both qubits measured.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.x(1)
qc.cz(0, 1)
qc.x(1)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)
qc.cz(0, 1)
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.measure(0, 0)
qc.measure(1, 1)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(2)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.H(q[1]),
    cirq.X(q[1]),
    cirq.CZ(q[0], q[1]),
    cirq.X(q[1]),
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.H(q[1]),
    cirq.X(q[0]),
    cirq.X(q[1]),
    cirq.CZ(q[0], q[1]),
    cirq.X(q[0]),
    cirq.X(q[1]),
    cirq.H(q[0]),
    cirq.H(q[1]),
    cirq.measure(q[0], key="c0"),
    cirq.measure(q[1], key="c1"),
)
code.pennylane:
import pennylane as qml

dev = qml.device("default.qubit", wires=2)


@qml.qnode(dev)
def circuit():
    qml.Hadamard(wires=0)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=1)
    qml.PauliX(wires=1)
    qml.CZ(wires=[0, 1])
    qml.PauliX(wires=1)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=0)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=1)
    qml.PauliX(wires=0)
    qml.PauliX(wires=1)
    qml.CZ(wires=[0, 1])
    qml.PauliX(wires=0)
    qml.PauliX(wires=1)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=0)
    qml.Hadamard(wires=1)
    # measured: q0 -> c0, q1 -> c1
    return qml.probs(wires=[0, 1])
